title: Legacy Loom
description: Legacy Loom weaves classic Minecraft textures into modern versions. Relive the nostalgia of older blocks and items, fully compatible with the latest game updates.
body:
### this pack must be used overtop of the "Programmer Art" pack which is provided in-game

All the textures you know and love, as well as old-school reinterpretations of modern features (see the 'Summary of Changes' below!). The pack makes efficient use of resourcepack technology, allowing for features such as Beta fog and greyscale lighting in pure Vanilla (+ more). We've worked very hard on this project and hope you enjoy it as much as we did making it!

if you like it, let us know! and let your friends know too!


<details>
<summary>Summary of Changes: (Click to expand)</summary>

~ Not exhaustive ~

* Beta textures
* Beta sounds
* Beta lighting (in vanilla, it is simply greyscale)
* Beta fog
* Beta sky
* Beta grass/foliage colors
* Beta water color
* Beta item labels / tooltips
* Beta GUI and text
* Old models (including chests and mobs with CEM)
* Achievements
* Beta wool & sheep colors
* Implemented unused legacy textures
* Beta style on everything!

and much more :)

</details>


<details>
<summary>Recommended Settings: (Click to expand)</summary>

Video Settings:
--- Biome Blend: 15x15 (Maximum)
--- Brightness: Moody (+0%)
--- Mipmap Levels: OFF

OptiFine Settings: (You don't *need* OptiFine, but if you use it, these settings are the best for this pack.)
--- Quality...
------- Emissive Textures: ON
------- Custom Sky: ON
------- Custom Entity Models: ON
------- Custom Colors: ON

</details>

<details>
<summary>Fabric mods that replicate OptiFine's features. (Click to expand)</summary>

[​EMF] Entity Model Features / EMF is an, OptiFine format, Custom Entity Model replacement mod available for Fabric and Forge.
[​ETF] Entity Texture Features / Emissive, Random & Custom texture support for entities in resource packs just like OptiFine but for Fabric.
Animatica / A mod implementing the OptiFine/MCPatcher animated texture format.
CIT Resewn / Re-implements MCPatcher's CIT. (custom item textures from OptiFine resource packs)
Continuity / A Fabric mod that allows for efficient connected textures.
Iris Shaders / A modern shader pack loader for Minecraft intended to be compatible with existing OptiFine shader packs.
Lithium / No-compromises game logic/server optimization mod.
OptiGUI / Blazing fast custom GUI textures on Fabric and Quilt with built-in OptiFine custom GUI resource pack support.
Sodium / The fastest and most compatible rendering optimization mod for Minecraft.
Starlight (Archived and won't be updated past 1.20.4) / Rewrites the light engine to fix lighting performance and lighting errors.

</details>
